words.reason: A button is a control you press.
An icon is a small symbol.
A field is an input.
A message is the copy a component shows.
A label names a value.
A row is one line in a list or table.
A card is a grouped surface.
A bar is a strip of controls.
A box is the chrome of a field, as in a search box or a check box.
An item is one entry in a list or nav.
Primary is the main variant.
Secondary is the quieter variant.
Danger is the destructive variant.
Error is a failure status.
Info is a neutral status.
Success is a positive status.
Warning is a caution status.
Small is a size.
Large is a size.
Disabled is an interaction state.
Active is an interaction state.
Selected is an interaction state.
On is a switch state.
Off is a switch state.
State is a condition of a component, as in an empty state or an error state.
Type is a variant property, as in Type=Primary.
Size is a variant property.
Style is a variant property.
Variant names which option of a component.
Total is a quantity on a value.
Digit is a length on a code field, as in a 6 digit box.
User is the person a profile or an avatar represents.
Code is the value typed into a promo, coupon, or access field.
Sign is a label on a button, as in sign in.
Terms is the agreement next to a checkbox.
Submit is the action on a button or a progress mark.
Submitting is the action on a progress mark.
Phone is the kind of value in a text field.
Number is the kind of value in a text field.
Country is a qualifier on a phone field.
Edit is the action on a button.
Save is the action on a button.
A control is the thing you operate, as in a quantity control.
A display is the readout of a value.
A menu is the list a nav entry sits in.
An entry is one item in a menu, or the box you type into.
An overlay is the layer a dialog sits on.
A line is the stroke of a separator.
A thumbnail is a small preview of a photo.
A fade is a transient motion on a notice.

trailing.reason: A window after a modal or a dialog is that surface.
A mark after close or icon is the symbol on that control.
A banner after a warning or an alert is that notice.
An account after a dropdown or a select is that picker.
A count after a badge is that badge. It does not keep company with a different component.
